_comment: Reference Etsy fee schedule used ONLY for internal profit estimation. These are NOT hard-coded into calculation logic — Finance Agent reads this file. Etsy changes fees periodically: verify against https://www.etsy.com/legal/fees/ and update this file (bump `version` + `lastVerified`) rather than editing formulas in code. All figures are Etsy's public standard seller fees as commonly published; treat as an ESTIMATE, not an invoice.

regulatoryOperatingFeePctByCountry._comment: Etsy's 'regulatory operating fee' applies only in specific regions (e.g. some EU countries, UK, Turkey). Set the seller's country below.

paymentProcessing._comment: Etsy Payments processing fee = pct * (item price + shipping) + fixed, varies by seller country/currency.
